class.name: NNBTRunOnce
class.brief_description: Runs its child until it finishes once, then keeps returning that result without running it again.
class.description: Use when a branch (or an entire tree under [NNBTRoot]) should execute only once, such as one-time initialization or a scripted intro. Once the child returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], that result is latched for all future ticks until [method NNBTNodes.reset] is called or the node is disabled and re-enabled.
